```text
1	# CLAUDE.md
2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## Commands
6	
7	```bash
8	npm run dev      # start dev server (Vite, tries 5173+ until a free port is found)
9	npm run build    # tsc type-check + Vite production build
10	npm run lint     # ESLint
11	npm run preview  # serve the production build locally
12	```
13	
14	No test framework is configured.
15	
16	## Architecture
17	
18	Single-page React app with two views — **Setup** and **Grid** — controlled by a `view` state string in `App.tsx`. No router.
19	
20	### Data flow
21	
22	1. `Setup` collects a Figma Personal Access Token (persisted to `localStorage`) and a file URL.
23	2. `parseFigmaUrl` (`src/lib/figma.ts`) extracts the `fileKey` from any Figma URL format (`/file/`, `/design/`, `/proto/`).
24	3. `useFigmaFile` hook calls the Figma REST API: `GET /v1/files/{fileKey}?depth=2` to get all pages and their top-level `FRAME`/`COMPONENT` nodes, then `GET /v1/images/{fileKey}` in batches of 50 to fetch PNG thumbnails.
25	4. `ScreenGrid` renders the results with page-tab filtering and name search. Each `ScreenCard` opens a prototype jump URL on click.
26	
27	### State and view transitions
28	
29	- `App.tsx` uses `effectiveView` to guard the grid: if `load()` throws or returns no screens, it stays on `setup` even though `setView('grid')` was called.
30	- The Figma token is persisted to `localStorage` under the key `figview:token` (see `Setup.tsx:TOKEN_KEY`).
31	- `FigmaConfig.protoFileKey` exists in `types.ts` but is not currently populated or used anywhere.
32	
33	### Figma prototype URL format
34	
35	```
36	https://www.figma.com/proto/{fileKey}/{slug}?node-id={nodeId}&scaling=contain&hide-ui=1
37	```
38	
39	Node IDs from the API use `:` (e.g. `1:23`) — these must be replaced with `-` for prototype URLs.
40	
41	### Styling
42	
43	All styles are in `src/index.css` (no CSS modules, no Tailwind). Design tokens are CSS custom properties on `:root`. Fonts are IBM Plex Mono (body/mono) and Syne (display/headings), loaded from Google Fonts in `index.html`.
44	
45	### TypeScript strictness
46	
47	`tsconfig.app.json` enables `strict`, `noUnusedLocals`, and `noUnusedParameters`. The build (`tsc -b`) will fail on unused variables.
48
```
</details></tool-use>

329	  const isShareViewer = Boolean(shareParams);

331	    isShareViewer && shareParams ? buildMinimalFigmaDesignUrl(shareParams.fileKey) : undefined;
332	
333	  useEffect(() => {
334	    if (!shareParams || screens.length > 0 || loading) return;
335	    const token = localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY)?.trim();
336	    if (!token) return;
337	    void load({
338	      token,
339	      fileKey: shareParams.fileKey,
340	      rawUrl: buildMinimalFigmaDesignUrl(shareParams.fileKey),
341	    });
342	  }, [shareParams, screens.length, loading, load]);
343	
344	  const shareBootstrapOrder =
345	    shareParams && fileKey === shareParams.fileKey ? shareParams.order : null;
346	
347	  if (screens.length > 0) {
348	    return (
349	      <FigviewApp
350	        key={`${fileKey}:${loadSessionId}`}
351	        screens={screens}
352	        fileName={fileName}
353	        fileKey={fileKey}
354	        loading={loading}
355	        progress={progress}
356	        error={error}
357	        load={load}
358	        reset={reset}
359	        shareBootstrapOrder={shareBootstrapOrder}
360	        isShareViewer={isShareViewer}
361	      />
362	    );
363	  }
364	
365	  return (
366	    <>
367	      {loading && <Loader message={progress || 'Loading…'} />}

372	        progress={progress}

1	export interface ShareLinkParams {
2	  fileKey: string;
3	  order: string[] | null;
4	}
5	
6	function encodeOrderPayload(ids: string[]): string {
7	  const json = JSON.stringify(ids);
8	  const b64 = btoa(json);
9	  return encodeURIComponent(b64);
10	}
11	
12	export function decodeOrderPayload(param: string): string[] | null {
13	  try {
14	    const b64 = decodeURIComponent(param);
15	    const json = atob(b64);
16	    const parsed = JSON.parse(json) as unknown;
17	    if (!Array.isArray(parsed) || !parsed.every((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string')) {
18	      return null;
19	    }
20	    return parsed;
21	  } catch {
22	    return null;
23	  }
24	}
25	
26	export function readShareParamsFromLocation(href?: string): ShareLinkParams | null {
27	  if (typeof window === 'undefined' && !href) return null;
28	  const url = href ?? window.location.href;
29	  let q: URLSearchParams;
30	  try {
31	    q = new URL(url).searchParams;
32	  } catch {
33	    return null;
34	  }
35	  if (q.get('view') !== 'share') return null;
36	  const fileKey = q.get('file')?.trim();
37	  if (!fileKey) return null;
38	  const orderRaw = q.get('order');
39	  const order = orderRaw ? decodeOrderPayload(orderRaw) : null;
40	  return { fileKey, order };
41	}
42	
43	export function buildShareViewUrl(opts: { fileKey: string; order: string[]; baseHref?: string }): string {
44	  const base = opts.baseHref ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.href : '');
45	  const u = new URL(base);
46	  u.search = '';
47	  u.hash = '';
48	  u.searchParams.set('view', 'share');

28	export function mergeOrderWithScreens(order: string[] | null | undefined, screens: ScreenFrame[]): string[] {

30	  const seen = new Set<string>();

58	/** Move item at `from` to index `to` (same array length). */
59	export function moveIndexInArray<T>(arr: T[], from: number, to: number): T[] {
60	  const len = arr.length;
61	  if (len === 0) return arr;
62	  const f = Math.max(0, Math.min(from, len - 1));
63	  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(to, len - 1));
64	  if (f === t) return [...arr];
65	  const next = [...arr];
66	  const [item] = next.splice(f, 1);
67	  next.splice(t, 0, item);
68	  return next;
69	}

71	export function reorderGlobalFromFilteredMove(
72	  globalOrder: string[],
73	  filteredOrderedIds: string[],
74	  from: number,
75	  to: number
76	): string[] {
77	  if (filteredOrderedIds.length === 0) return globalOrder;
78	  const F = [...filteredOrderedIds];
79	  const clampedFrom = Math.max(0, Math.min(from, F.length - 1));
80	  const clampedTo = Math.max(0, Math.min(to, F.length - 1));
81	  const [moved] = F.splice(clampedFrom, 1);
82	  F.splice(clampedTo, 0, moved);
83	  const filteredSet = new Set(F);
84	  const filIndices = globalOrder.map((id, i) => (filteredSet.has(id) ? i : -1)).filter(i => i >= 0);
85	  if (filIndices.length !== F.length) return globalOrder;
86	  const out = globalOrder.slice();
87	  F.forEach((id, j) => {
88	    out[filIndices[j]] = id;
89	  });
90	  return out;
91	}
